title: MME-VideoOCR: Evaluating OCR-Based Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Video Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a debiasing test by evaluating models on questions without meaningful visual input (e.g., providing no image or a black image) to quantify the model's reliance on pre-trained textual co-occurrence patterns and knowledge leakage rather than actual visual OCR evidence.
